content.value_statement: Release teams lose time turning technical commits into clear updates. This skill converts git history into structured changelogs and release notes for users.
actual_capabilities: Analyzes git commit history for a selected release, date range, or recent period.
Groups changes into features, improvements, fixes, breaking changes, and security updates.
Rewrites technical commit messages into user-facing release note language.
Filters internal commits such as tests, refactors, and maintenance noise.
Formats notes for changelog files, GitHub releases, app stores, and update messages.
limitations: Requires access to a repository with useful git commit history.
Generated notes need human review before public release.
Commit messages with little context can produce incomplete summaries.
It does not verify product behavior or test released code.

use_cases.title: Prepare Customer Updates
use_cases.description: Turn a week of commits into a concise update for customers and internal stakeholders.

use_cases.title: Draft Version Release Notes
use_cases.description: Create structured release notes from tags, versions, or date ranges before publishing.

use_cases.title: Write Channel-Specific Copy
use_cases.description: Adapt the same change set for GitHub releases, app stores, emails, or product pages.

prompt_templates.title: Create A Recent Changelog
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a changelog from commits since the last release. Use clear user-facing language.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a standard release summary.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize A Date Range
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate release notes for commits between March 1 and March 15. Group changes by user impact.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a focused reporting window.

prompt_templates.title: Apply Team Guidelines
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a changelog from commits since v2.4.0. Follow CHANGELOG_STYLE.md and flag breaking changes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request with a local style guide.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Multi-Channel Notes
prompt_templates.prompt: Create release notes for version 2.5.0. Include a public changelog, GitHub summary, and app store update text.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced release workflow for several publishing channels.

output_examples.input: Commits from the past week include workspace sharing, keyboard shortcuts, faster sync, and upload fixes.
output_examples.output: A weekly update with New Features, Improvements, and Fixes sections. Each item explains the user benefit in plain language.

output_examples.input: Version 2.5.0 includes faster sync, better search, and resolved image upload failures.
output_examples.output: A release note draft that highlights faster syncing, better search coverage, and fixed image uploads.

output_examples.input: Commits since v2.4.0 include API auth changes, UI fixes, and documentation updates.
output_examples.output: A changelog that separates breaking changes from fixes and marks items that need reviewer confirmation.

best_practices: Run the skill from the repository root so git history is available.
Provide release dates, version numbers, or tags when you need focused output.
Review the draft for accuracy, tone, and missing customer context.
anti_patterns: Do not publish generated notes without product owner review.
Do not expect vague commit messages to produce detailed customer benefits.
Do not include internal refactors unless they change user behavior.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates user-facing changelogs, release notes, update summaries, and related launch copy from git commits.

faq.question: Which tools support this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it follow my changelog style guide?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide a style guide file or describe your format, tone, and required sections.

faq.question: Does it replace release review?
faq.answer: No. A product owner or release manager should review every generated note before publication.

faq.question: What inputs work best?
faq.answer: Version tags, dates, concise commit messages, and known customer impact produce the best results.

faq.question: Can it create GitHub or app store notes?
faq.answer: Yes. Ask for the target channel so the wording and length match that destination.
